svg.title: Proofable on AgentGovBench: 48 of 48 governance scenarios handled
svg.desc: AgentGovBench, the open 48-scenario agent-governance benchmark. Proofable's policy engine handles all 48 (measured on the library revision of 20 October 2026, calling the policy code directly). The comparator rows are the benchmark maintainers' published runs on the earlier library: the agent tools on their own each handle 13, Cursor with the ACP gateway 37, and Claude Code or Codex with ACP 43. The scenarios and scorer are the same; the setups are not, so these are not a ranking.
